title: The Echo of the Deep
author: Orsen Dunmore
blurb: Vesper Vane, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
